title: Issue Bias in Generative AI Writing Assistance: Political Issues and LLMs in the Swedish 2026 Election

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with 107 Swedish policy propositions crossed with 77 writing templates and varying framings (neutral, positive, negative), classifying the generated stances using an LLM judge, and comparing the models' aggregated positions against the ideological stances of Sweden's political parties.
